 1 | Heat Resistance | caster | 1 min/lvl | self | U

 7 | Resist Poison | caster | C | self | Us

12 | Neutralize Poison | caster | varies | self | Us

20 | Unpain IV | caster | 1 min/lvl | self | U

30 | Awake True | caster | - | self | Us
50 | Unpain True | caster | 1 min/lvl | self | U

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster is protected from natural heat up to 170ºF (treat as if target were in
70ºF temperature). For temperatures above 170ºF, subtract 100ºF to determine
the effective temperature for the target. Caster also receives +20 to all RRs
versus heat spells and heat attacks (+20 DB versus elemental fire and heat
attacks).
@@ 2
Caster is protected from natural cold down to 20ºF (treat as if target were in
70ºF temperature). For temperatures below 20ºF, add 50ºF to determine the
effective temperature for the target. Caster also receives +20 to all RRs
versus cold spells and cold attacks (+20 DB versus elemental cold and cold
attacks).
@@ 5
Caster is able to sustain an additional 25% of his total concussion hits
(round off) before passing out. Hits are still taken and remain when the
duration expires.
@@ 6
Relieves 1 round’s worth of accumulated stun.
@@ 7
Delays the effect of a poison as long as the caster concentrates.
@@ 10
As Unpain I, except 50% additional hits may be sustained.
@@ 11
As Stun Relief I, except 3 rounds are relieved.
@@ 12
Has a 50% chance of neutralizing a poison (modified by potency of the poison)
if the caster is unconscious or concentrates for one hour. In any case, it
delays the poison for as long as the caster can concentrate.
@@ 14
Will awaken the caster from any unnatural sleep (e.g., Sleep spell, sleeping
drug, etc.). Caster takes one round to awaken.
@@ 15
As Unpain I, except 75% additional hits may be sustained.
@@ 17
As Heat Resistance, except caster is immune to natural heat and takes 50%
normal damage from heat spells.
@@ 18
As Cold Resistance, except caster is also immune to natural cold and takes 50%
normal damage from cold spells.
@@ 20
As Unpain I, except 100% additional hits may be sustained.
@@ 25
As Neutralize Poison, except chance of neutralization is 100% (modified).
@@ 30
As Awake, except there is no delay and it can be used with normal sleep and
set to be triggered by any activity (e.g., attack, danger, etc.).
@@ 50
As Unpain IV, except caster ignores all pain. He will be active until he takes
more than: [2 x normal hits + Temporary Constitution]. He ignores all
penalties due to wounds (i.e., negative modifications to actions). When he
exceeds this limit, he does not pass out; he dies from system shock.
